paragraphs: At opening, start the circulation desk and process lending, returns, and renewals. Patrol shelves to return misplaced items and add new books. Answer reader questions and refer unresolved records for cataloging. Before leaving, reconcile system records and report damaged or missing copies.

In short, they organize books and serve readers well. Duties include lending, shelving, catalog maintenance, consultation, collection organization, and program support, combining physical and communication work as stewards of library materials.
